description: Permissions for the launcher webview (`main`) only. Desktop: each site is a child WebView inside the same window, so the grant is scoped to the `main` webview rather than the window; site child WebViews get no capability. Android: the launcher keeps the Tauri webview on the Default profile. Every site opens in a separate native WebView bound to its own androidx.webkit profile, so a site page is NOT the launcher webview and receives no Tauri capability or IPC bridge. The launcher IPC is installed by AnimeHubPlugin.restrictIpcToLauncher as a WebMessageListener restricted to http(s)://tauri.localhost, main frame only; wry`s JavaScript interface is removed first and failure to install the listener fails closed. No `remote` capability exists. See docs/android-navigation.md and docs/security-residual-risks.md.
